recipe.variant: RealESRGAN_x4plus 4x per frame, then ImageScaleBy 0.5 = 2x output with the per-frame GAN noise averaged out (the 4x -> 2x supersample)
recipe.from_template: utility-gan_upscaler + its own note ('Upscale 4x first, then use a resize node to bring it down to your target resolution'); the 4x->2x supersample as the per-frame shimmer mitigation is community-confirmed (artokun, comfyui.org, nomadoor).
recipe.confidence_note: graph and tip are the official template's; the shimmer rationale is community-confirmed (3 sources)

video.note: the clip; frames, audio and fps come out of GetVideoComponents, audio and fps pass through to CreateVideo; the model only touches the frames

recipe.defaults_note: 2x effective. Still per-frame: for a temporally coherent result use SeedVR2 (native) or FlashVSR (pack).
verify: PASSED offline structural check against the v0.35.0 registry on 2026-10-01 (classes, input keys incl. dynamic combos, links/types, enums, ranges, output node). Not yet run on a box.
